title: Michelle
feel: Fingerpicked/brushed, about 120 bpm (estimate); F major verses, F minor intro and bridge

sections.name: Intro
sections.bars: Fm Fm(maj7) | Fm7 Fm6 | Dbmaj7 | C

sections.name: Verse
sections.bars: F | Bbm7 | Eb6 | Ddim7 | C Ddim7 | C
sections.note: The record's bar 2 is B♭7♯9; charts write B♭m7. Ddim7 = B°7 (same notes).

sections.name: Bridge
sections.bars: Fm | % | Ab7 | Db | C | Fm | Fm Fm(maj7) | Fm7 Fm6 | Dbmaj7 | C
sections.note: The last four bars are the intro figure returning.

why: A **descending line cliché in minor** (m – m(maj7) – m7 – m6), **diminished-7th passing chords**, and a 7♯9 colour.
hard_change: **E♭6 → D°7 → C**: three new grips in two bars. Learn D°7 xx0101 as “two fingers, two open strings”.
theory: The verse mixes major I with minor-key iv (B♭m). °7 = vii°7/V. Bridge: V/VI (A♭7) → VI (D♭) → V.
steps: Changes alone, slowly: the intro cliché, then E♭6 → D°7 → C.
With the record (played capo 5 with C-shapes on the record; these are the no-capo grips).
